newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Change in Gallagher control, talks continue.
newsitem.headline: Change in Gallagher control, talks continue.

text.p: Gallagher Estate Holdings Ltd said on Friday the Riccia Group Holdings Ltd had bought in excess of 50 percent of its share capital by buying shares at 60 cents each.
It said an offer would be made to minorities for all or part of their Gallagher shares at 60 cents each. Further details will be published later.
Gallagher further warned shareholders that it was in talks with more than one party for the sale of the Riccia group's stake in Gallagher and advised cautious share dealings.
